Resolved so far: the reviewed development landings and source commits are recorded in [the v0.15.0 issue reconciliation](https://github.com/ligon/LSMS_Library/blob/8d7a5e55914e700c69ae1a195f96cc2282b6ce64/slurm_logs/release_landing_2026-10-14/RELEASE_ISSUES.org) (PR #998). This issue remains open for the scope below.

Names without a directory now raise ValueError immediately with near-miss suggestions. The first half is covered by tests and the fixture repairs preserve that behavior.

Remaining: existing directories without a Data Scheme still construct. Decide whether the accepted set must exactly match countries(), including acquisition/scaffold use cases, and reconcile both API docstrings with that decision. Raising for Ghana is not proof that .dvc or a bare scaffold is refused.

**Ruling (@ligon, 2026-10-18)**, from the framework-backlog decision sheet: `Country()` refuses an existing directory with no `_/data_scheme.yml`. Acquisition and scaffold code gets an explicit, documented opt-in. Reconcile both docstrings so the accepted set equals `countries()`.

Scheduled for the overnight 2026-10-18 sweep.
